Form Guidelines
  • All fields marked with * are required
  • Trip codes should be unique and contain only letters and numbers
  • Use clear, descriptive names for better searchability
  • Include star ratings in resort information (e.g., "Resort Name, 4 stars")
  • Prices will be automatically formatted with currency symbols
  • Provide high-quality image URLs for better presentation
